land.label: Land, about 2 acres on SH 46
land.assumption: The 2025 asking price the research found for a commercially zoned SH 46 corridor tract of about 1.98 acres near I-10, about $15 a square foot. The listing is not cited so that no real parcel is identified; its price was last updated in January 2025, and an appraisal sets the value.

building_site.label: Tunnel building, vacuum canopies and site work
building_site.assumption: No local construction cost was found. The 2025 Tommy's Express disclosure prices construction of its 130-foot model at $2,056,978 to $3,930,750, including a building structure of $803,411 to $853,190 [^30]; a state-filed estimate for a 4,696 square foot San Antonio express wash building was $1.25 million [^34]. The line sits in the lower half of the franchise range and above the San Antonio building-only figure because it also covers paving, drainage and vacuum canopies.

equipment.label: Tunnel equipment, conveyor, pay stations and vacuums
equipment.assumption: A Texas contractor quotes tunnel equipment packages at $1.4 million to $2.1 million for 2026 [^33]; the line sits in the middle of that range and includes pay stations and the vacuum system. Steel and aluminum input prices rose sharply in the year to August 2026 [^37], so the low end is not used.

soft.label: Design, permits, flood work and contingency
soft.assumption: The 2025 Tommy's Express disclosure gives soft costs of $107,563 to $582,000 [^30]. The line sits in the upper part of that range because the lot's flood status is unresolved, which can add engineering, elevation and permit work, and it carries a construction contingency.

members.label: Average active members
members.assumption: No member count for any Seguin wash was found. The ramp stabilizes between the fleet averages a lender can compute from Mister (about 2.3 million members at 548 sites, 2025) [^27] and Zips (about 625,000 members at more than 260 sites, February 2025) [^19], and below the 4,000-member size where a vendor panel saw 11.1% retail-to-member conversion [^38]. Four incumbents within about 3 miles keep it below the larger chain's average.

member_price.label: Average member price per month
member_price.assumption: Finish Line posts unlimited plans at $14 to $29 and Pic-n-Pac at $20 to $40 a month, both checked October 15, 2026 [^16,17]. The blend sits near the low middle of the combined range, assuming most members take a middle plan and some take opening discounts. Cosmic Express prices were not found.

retail_washes.label: Retail (single) washes
retail_washes.assumption: No local wash counts were found. Retail volume grows slowly while members grow, in line with a vendor panel that saw retail revenue fall 3% while membership revenue rose 10% in Q3 2025 [^38].

retail_ticket.label: Average retail ticket
retail_ticket.assumption: Equals Finish Line's second single-wash tier and sits between Pic-n-Pac's $10 and $15 washes [^15,17].

labor_chem_pct.label: Labor and chemicals, share of revenue
labor_chem_pct.assumption: Mister Car Wash spent 28.7% of 2025 revenue on labor and chemicals [^28]; a single site lacks a chain's chemical purchasing scale, so the ratio is set slightly higher.

other_store_pct.label: Utilities, repairs, card fees, software and marketing, share of revenue
other_store_pct.assumption: Mister's other store operating expenses were 41.5% of 2025 revenue, including rent it guided at about $123 million [^28,29]. The subject owns its site and pays no rent, so the ratio leaves rent out but keeps room for a single site's utility and repair costs.

mgmt_pct.label: Management allowance, share of revenue
mgmt_pct.assumption: Stands in for owner management time. The market price of brand and operating support in this format is a 4% royalty plus a 1% brand fund in the 2025 Tommy's Express disclosure [^32].

insurance.label: Property, liability and flood insurance, Year 1
insurance.assumption: No insurance quote or market survey was found, and the lot's flood zone is not known. A placeholder for property, liability and flood cover; a quote is a lender condition.

cost_growth.label: Annual growth in insurance cost
cost_growth.assumption: General allowance for premium growth; no local insurance cost series was found.

tax_rate.label: Property tax rate, Seguin ISD area, 2025

tpl_rate.label: Bank first-lien rate
tpl_rate.assumption: Prime was 7.00% on October 9, 2026 [^46]. The bank holds a first lien at half of cost, its lowest-risk position, so the rate is set a quarter point over Prime, far below SBA's cap on the third-party spread. The lender sets the rate at pricing

tpl_amort_years.label: Bank first-lien amortization
tpl_amort_years.assumption: Matches the 25-year debenture term; the bank's term must meet SBA's minimum for a 25-year debenture [^44].
